title: Control plane Terraform module: graceful state sync, upgrade probes, and proactive health checks
creator: Jordan Mills
description: We need a Terraform module and orchestration patterns to ensure the Redwood Private EKS control plane can be provisioned and upgraded with minimal blast radius. This ticket covers three tightly related areas: (1) graceful state sync between operator and Terraform to avoid resource drift during upgrades; (2) implement pre-upgrade and in-flight health probes that gate rolling upgrades; and (3) proactive health-checking and automated remediation hooks (non-destructive) for control plane components. The goal is to reduce upgrade-induced incidents and provide clear observable signals and automated safe rollbacks when SLOs are at risk.
acceptance_criteria:
- Terraform module exposes a deterministic state sync hook that checkpoints operator-managed resources before an upgrade.
- Pre-upgrade probe job runs validation plan and fails fast with readable diagnostics if incompatibilities are found.
- A set of Kubernetes liveness/readiness and control-plane specific probes are defined and packaged as module defaults (configurable).
- Rollout orchestration uses probe signals to pause/cancel an in-flight upgrade and trigger a documented remediation playbook.
- End-to-end e2e test in CI (using a small dev cluster) validates upgrade pause/resume and rollback behavior.
- Docs for SRE/SE describing the health signals, runbook, and operator flags are published to Confluence.
test_plan:
1) Unit test terraform plan generation for common upgrade scenarios.
2) Integration: create a dev EKS control plane in staging-vpc, apply module v1, then apply v2 with an intentional kernel/parameter change to trigger probe failure. Verify upgrade pauses.
3) Chaos test: simulate node OOM and verify remediation hook only attempts non-destructive fixes and emits alerts.
4) Smoke: validate canary traffic route remains healthy during control plane partial upgrades.
5) CI: run automated e2e job in GitHub Actions that asserts health probe metrics and state reconciliation.
implementation_notes:
- Add a terraform null_resource 'preflight_check' that runs a k8s job (via kubectl provider) to validate CRD compatibility, IAM role bindings, and KMS permissions.
- Use a 'state_snapshot' S3 object (versioned) to capture key control plane labels/annotations used by operator; module should support a safe hash compare to detect unexpected drifts.
- Probes: extend existing module to include a 'probeConfig' map that defines thresholds (e.g., API server latency > 200ms for 5m => pause).
- Upgrade orchestration: integrate with the existing controlplane provisioner operator (see ENG-47205) to surface probe decisions via a CRD field 'upgradeStatus' and signal to terraform apply via an external data source poll.
- Backoff policy: exponential backoff with a maximum pause window of 2 hours before triggering manual intervention.
- Avoid hard-coding cloud account IDs; use module variables and clear input validation.
comments: 2025-11-03 Jordan Mills: Created ticket after post-mortem from incident INC-2025-09 where an upgrade introduced temporary API server throttling. Root cause was operator and terraform applying overlapping changes during rolling upgrades.

2025-11-04 Rae Chen: Spiked design for state snapshot approach. Implemented a proof-of-concept using S3 versioned object + object lock to prevent accidental overwrites. Observed that snapshot size is small (~12KB). Pushing patch to terraform-modules branch 'state-snapshot'.

2025-11-05 Design review (Heather Li): Requested clearer UX for probe thresholds — make defaults conservative and surface override examples in README. Also asked to include a 'dry-run' mode for preflight checks.

2025-11-07 Engineering note (Rae Chen): Prototype preflight_check null_resource implemented. Found race where operator reconciler immediately repaired CRDs before probe job could finish; adding short lease-based lock (coordination via a ConfigMap 'upgrade-lock') to avoid races.

2025-11-08 QA (Diego Ramos): Ran integration test in staging: pre-upgrade probe detected KMS policy downgrade (intended) and correctly blocked upgrade. Filed follow-up ENG-50811 to improve diagnostics output format.
2025-11-09 Security (Maya Patel): Reviewed KMS usage and approved approach; requested that the S3 snapshot uses SSE-KMS with a module-provided KMS key alias. Marked security_review_required=true.

2025-11-10 Code review (PR #204): Alex Gomez suggested replacing shelling out to kubectl with the provider-managed kubernetes_job resource to avoid depending on runner tooling. Accepted and updated branch.
2025-11-11 Reliability (SRE team): Suggested adding a metric 'controlplane.upgrade_pause_count' and a dashboard tile. Created Grafana panel PR and added to console dashboards list.
